title: begonia multangula var. glabrata
intro: Begonia multangula var. glabrata, commonly known as  Begonia glabrata, is a plant species belonging to the Begoniaceae family. The plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The health benefits of Begonia glabrata include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against oxidative stress, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
